original_ambiguities.detail: 24 versus 30 days; cutting 5/7/9 versus 6/8/12; finishing 6/7/10 versus 6/8/12.
Medium segment model1 references economic market B91, not its B105. Both original caches equal 3500; baseline equality hides dependency error.
Medium and premium model2 quality percentages divide by economic reputation total D132, not their own totals. Default company reputations are equal across examples, hiding dependency difference.
Zero total quantity causes division by zero; literal original contains no guard.
Capacity allocation can exceed an individual desired plan; later MIN limits actual output. ROUNDDOWN allocations may leave capacity unallocated.
6 reels convert to 1500 m but purchase example AB82 values only 6 m; inventory values 1500 m.

rules_absent.detail: No inverse planner/optimization/rounding recipe from quantity to staff, machines or lead time.
CONS-06 describes overtime but supplies no amount or percentage.
CONS-07 describes storage but supplies no monetary rate.
CONS-05 increases next loan rate without number of percentage points.
No universal material-waste percentage; explicit BOM and efficiency/capacity equations must remain distinct.
Original has no complete per-cycle cash ledger integrating loans, sales collection schedules, salaries, acquisitions and inventory; game transition needs declared extensions.
Catalog names units-of-production method but no lifetime output of 100000 units is defined.
Economic price min=max division is unguarded; game tie fallback is an extension.
Price-ideal formula can be negative; original has no clamp in that cell.
